A run's epidemiology over one window of days

Source: R/metrics.R
summarise_run.Rd

One row that summarises a run over a window of its days, by default the second half. Every column covers the same days, so the rows of different runs, or of a grid, mean the same thing.

Usage

summarise_run(
  run,
  burn_frac = 0.5,
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  exclude_masked = FALSE
)

Arguments

run

a run: a vivax_run (from run_sim() or load_run()) or the path of a run directory.

burn_frac

the share of SIM_DAYS left out as burn-in, at least 0 and below 1: the window starts on day round(SIM_DAYS * burn_frac) + 1. Not with from.

from, to

the window's first and last days, both included: from = 0 is day 1, and to = NULL is SIM_DAYS.

exclude_masked

if TRUE, leave masked relapses out of every relapse column.

Value

a one-row data.table, nothing rounded:

  • the window and the run: from_tick, to_tick and n_days (integer), exclude_masked, extinct and never_started (logical), and extinct_tick (integer, NA for a run that did not go extinct);

  • host state, over the window's host-days: prevalence_frac (the share with a patent clone), coi_mean and coi_median (patent lineages per infected host-day) and polyclonal_frac (the share of infected host-days with two or more), each NA with no infected host-day, and hypnozoites_per_host;

  • rates per person-year: eir_per_py (infectious bites; NA for a state table without infectious_bites), foi_per_py (new clones from bites and imports), molfob_clones_per_py (and from relapses), molfob_episodes_per_py (and from recrudescences) and relapses_per_py_at_risk (NA with no time at risk);

  • fractions: relapse_frac_episodes and relapse_frac_acquisitions, as relapse_fraction() gives them, and imported_frac (imports among the new clones from bites and imports), each NA with nothing to divide;

  • counts (integer): n_imported, n_local_reinfection, n_relapse, n_relapse_masked, n_recrudescence and n_bloodstage_courses (blood-stage courses, by case management or MDA);

  • denominators: person_years and person_years_at_risk.

Details

The window. The first burn_frac of the run's SIM_DAYS days are burn-in, so the window is days round(SIM_DAYS * burn_frac) + 1 to SIM_DAYS; from and to set it directly. A run that went extinct, or never started, is summarised over the same days, the days after its last state row counting as days with no parasite. A run that stopped early without either record is refused unless to is at most its last recorded day.

What is counted. Cases are the clone onsets in the window, as classify_cases() gives them: a bite that delivers two genotypes is two new clones, though one infectious bite, and founder seeding is not an onset. A recrudescence is an episode but not an acquisition, so it is in molfob_episodes_per_py and relapse_frac_episodes only. Masked relapses, into a patent clone of their own lineage, are counted unless exclude_masked = TRUE leaves them out of every relapse column; n_relapse_masked counts them either way. NU_HYPNOZOITE_BATCH was fitted with every relapse counted (see relapse_fraction()).

Person-years. The EIR, FOI and molFOB divide by the person-years of every host, N_HOSTS times the window's days over 365. The relapse rate divides by the person-years at risk: each host counts from the day after its first infection by a bite or an import, a blood-stage primary or a hypnozoite batch, to the window's end; founder seeding does not put a host at risk.

Pooling. To pool runs, sum the counts and the person-years and divide, or weight each rate by its person-years: an average of rates weights a short or small run as much as a long one.

See also

force_of_infection(), relapse_fraction(), classify_cases(), plot_diagnostics()

Examples

run <- example_run()
summarise_run(run)                        # the second half of the run
#>    from_tick to_tick n_days exclude_masked extinct extinct_tick never_started
#>        <int>   <int>  <int>         <lgcl>  <lgcl>        <int>        <lgcl>
#> 1:       201     400    200          FALSE   FALSE           NA         FALSE
#>    prevalence_frac coi_mean coi_median polyclonal_frac hypnozoites_per_host
#>              <num>    <num>      <num>           <num>                <num>
#> 1:       0.2503333 1.338549          1       0.2563249             1.705667
#>    eir_per_py foi_per_py molfob_clones_per_py molfob_episodes_per_py
#>         <num>      <num>                <num>                  <num>
#> 1:   3.680417       2.92             6.722083               6.782917
#>    relapses_per_py_at_risk relapse_frac_episodes relapse_frac_acquisitions
#>                      <num>                 <num>                     <num>
#> 1:                 5.55657             0.5605381                 0.5656109
#>    imported_frac n_imported n_local_reinfection n_relapse n_relapse_masked
#>            <num>      <int>               <int>     <int>            <int>
#> 1:     0.1354167         13                  83       125               69
#>    n_recrudescence n_bloodstage_courses person_years person_years_at_risk
#>              <int>                <int>        <num>                <num>
#> 1:               2                   58     32.87671             22.49589
summarise_run(run, from = 101, to = 200)  # its second hundred days
#>    from_tick to_tick n_days exclude_masked extinct extinct_tick never_started
#>        <int>   <int>  <int>         <lgcl>  <lgcl>        <int>        <lgcl>
#> 1:       101     200    100          FALSE   FALSE           NA         FALSE
#>    prevalence_frac coi_mean coi_median polyclonal_frac hypnozoites_per_host
#>              <num>    <num>      <num>           <num>                <num>
#> 1:       0.1376667 1.179177          1       0.1791768            0.6933333
#>    eir_per_py foi_per_py molfob_clones_per_py molfob_episodes_per_py
#>         <num>      <num>                <num>                  <num>
#> 1:   1.885833   1.338333                 2.92                 3.1025
#>    relapses_per_py_at_risk relapse_frac_episodes relapse_frac_acquisitions
#>                      <num>                 <num>                     <num>
#> 1:                4.186149             0.5098039                 0.5416667
#>    imported_frac n_imported n_local_reinfection n_relapse n_relapse_masked
#>            <num>      <int>               <int>     <int>            <int>
#> 1:     0.1363636          3                  19        26               15
#>    n_recrudescence n_bloodstage_courses person_years person_years_at_risk
